card.name: Inside foreign-language names and titles
card.fires_on: Partway through non-English words in citations, URLs and transliterated terms, mostly Slovene book titles (Etimološki slovar) and Sanskrit or Spanish terms. It fires on the piece in the middle of the word, not on the start.
